native_mechanisms: A fixed upper row of beast-pawns and a second row the horse's-head piece may slip forward at exactly one house, tried unslipped and slipped at every possible house
House-by-house comparison marking a lotus petal for matching beasts and a red knot for disagreeing ones, paced one count per flute note (per-column match/mismatch tally)
Each trial's knots gathered into a fist and weighed, all fists but the lightest flung away (take the minimum total over the enumerated trials)
core_technique: Banded anti-diagonal Needleman-Wunsch DP (AVX2-vectorised, 3 rotating diagonals) whose band width W is seeded by a cheap single-gap prefix/suffix scan used only as an upper bound on the optimal score.
